title: "Plotly"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
execute: {warning: false}
---

```{r}
library(plotly)
plot_ly(mtcars, x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, color = ~factor(cyl), type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
```

```{r}
plot_ly(iris, x = ~Species, y = ~Sepal.Length, type = "box")
```
